notes: Sage annualises by days, the calculator by the statutory x12: 2c on PAYE, tolerated as documented rounding. Sage demo employee "david" (a Sage demo record, not a real person). Net is not on the Sage table: it is monthly pay less the Sage PAYE and employee UIF (no other deductions). ETI: nil by ETI Act s6(a), age outside 18-29.
